# c0mpute

> Decentralized compute marketplace. CLI-first. Pay workers with spare GPUs to run your jobs. Run your own GPU and earn. MIT-licensed, open source.

## Getting Started

- [Install](https://c0mpute.com/getting-started): One-line install via `curl -fsSL https://c0mpute.com/install.sh | sh`. Supports Linux and macOS (x86_64, aarch64).

## Run a node

- [Chat](https://c0mpute.com/chat): chat with open models served by c0mpute/Infernet provider nodes. Sign in with CoinPay (a CoinPay DID is required). Same chat from the CLI (`c0mpute chat login`, `c0mpute chat "prompt"`), an OpenAI-compatible API (base URL `https://c0mpute.com/v1`, `Authorization: Bearer c0k_...`), and MCP (`https://c0mpute.com/api/mcp`, tools chat, list_models, whoami; stdio via `c0mpute chat mcp`).
- [Run a node](https://c0mpute.com/providers): `curl -fsSL https://c0mpute.com/install.sh | sh` installs c0mpute and starts the worker (Linux, macOS, Windows via WSL2; CPU or GPU). The goal is 100,000 nodes, enough pooled capacity to train and serve open-weight models in the open.
- [GPU earnings estimates](https://c0mpute.com/estimates): choose a GPU and compare illustrative monthly scenarios using public GPU rental rates and assumed paid utilization. These are not actual c0mpute payouts or guaranteed earnings; anonymized payout averages by GPU are not published yet.
- [Market](https://c0mpute.com/market): GPU nodes online with each operator's listing. Fully competitive: every job is a sealed-bid auction under the buyer's cap and the lowest bid wins automatically; no rate card. `c0mpute pricing set --min <usd>` = dynamic pricing (starts at 60% of the cap, undercuts the winning price by 2% after a loss, probes up after a win, rises with queue load) never under the floor; 5% market fee on market jobs (the operator keeps 95%; Infernet charges the same 5% on paid inference and the two never stack); `--fixed <usd>` = one price. The listing (`pricing: {mode, min_usd, fixed_usd}`) is in https://c0mpute.com/api/nodes.
- [Node board](https://c0mpute.com/nodes): every node online now, ranked by `c0mpute bench` score, with the operator's nickname. JSON at https://c0mpute.com/api/nodes (`name` per node, `operators` = nodes online per nickname).
- Node nicknames: `c0mpute name <handle>` then restart the worker (`c0mpute worker stop && c0mpute worker start -d`), or install with `curl -fsSL https://c0mpute.com/install.sh | sh -s -- --name <handle>`. Stored in `~/.c0mpute/name`; `C0MPUTE_NAME` overrides it. Lowercase a-z, 0-9, - and _, up to 32 chars. Public and unverified; earnings follow the payout address, not the name. Needs 0.2.64+.
- [Benchmarks](https://c0mpute.com/benchmark): live CPU, cores, RAM, composite score and per-workload throughput for online nodes. These synthetic CPU workloads do not measure AI model inference speed.
- Referral links: https://c0mpute.com/r/<handle> gives an install line with `C0MPUTE_REF=<handle>`; nodes installed with it show the handle on the board. Public scoreboard, no payout.

## Docs

- [CLI Reference & Cookbook](https://c0mpute.com/docs): Full CLI walkthrough — identity/wallet, workers, transcode jobs, AI inference, reputation, plugins, health checks.

## Modules

- [Plugins](https://c0mpute.com/plugins): Three core modules — transcode (FFmpeg-based video encoding), coinpay (DID identity + escrow payments), infernet (AI LLM inference).

## Blog

- [Blog](https://c0mpute.com/blog): Project updates and articles.

- [GitHub](https://github.com/profullstack/c0mpute): Source code, design proposals (DIPs), and releases. MIT license.
